gates.description: Managed frontends (WASM, DEX, CIL, JVM) are registered and vertical pipelines pass.
Low-level VMEffects contracts preserved without fake native MachineEffects (M11-INV-001..003).
VMEffects lower cleanly to shared Semantic IR, CFG, and SSA with provenance (M11-INV-004, M11-INV-006).
Execution-authoritative metadata states hard constraints; interprocedural calls resolved conservatively (M11-INV-007).
Decompilation uses shared Semantic IR / HighIR without frontend-private shortcuts (M11-INV-004).
Exception clauses and handlers are modeled explicitly in CFG and summaries (M11-INV-008).
Host imports, JNI, and PInvoke are treated as explicit external boundaries (M11-INV-009).
Phase 9 solver and Phase 10 runtime hooks provide truthful status and do not fake M6 availability (M11-INV-010).
Capability maturity reflects verified M5 status with M6 unsupported.
The living integration diff remains inside the declared Phase 11 ownership envelope.
